title: Chapter 225 Zerg Exploration Army
content:
Chapter 225 Zerg Exploration Army

Wu Qing nodded and said, "Of course it's true!"

Naga didn't say anything more, and just said, "Deal!"

This important transaction negotiation between the Zerg and the Naga tribe was completed simply and refreshingly with a few words between Wu Qing and Naga 妶.

One of the important factors is that the Zerg destroyers participated in the Naga battlefield, and Wu Qing also benefited from it, so he took the initiative to make concessions, and the extent of the concessions was somewhat beyond the expectations of the Naga tribe.

Wu Qing could of course cut another knife and give a Zerg destroyer of about 250,000, and he could also reach a deal with the Naga tribe, but this would be a bit of a loss for the greater good, and it would be even less cost-effective if all things were considered together.

Facts have proved that Wu Qing's approach is correct.

The Zerg was willing to provide 500,000 Zerg destroyers. As soon as the news was passed back to the Naga tribe, the Zerg, a newly entered race, immediately gained the favor of the Naga tribe's high-level officials. Someone immediately proposed that the Naga tribe's resource call authority could be appropriately increased to give the Zerg more luck beads.

"The Zerg tribe is generous, but we, the Naga tribe, cannot appear stingy!"

This idea of his was supported by most of the Naga tribe's high-level officials.

When the actual transaction was made, Wu Qing discovered that the luck beads given by the Naga tribe were 10% more than the upper limit that the Naga tribe said, which was also a pleasant surprise.

The Naga tribe generously paid the luck beads first, and Wu Qing did not delay and immediately hatched the Zerg destroyers in the Zerg territory.

When the Zerg troops are hatched, they can choose the strength star level, and they can hatch high-star troops at once.

The Zerg territory sent out troops at full strength, and the speed was very fast. Soon, according to the Naga tribe's standards, 500,000 Zerg destroyers of one star and above were hatched.

This was the most resource-consuming expedition of the Zerg since its birth. In addition to consuming a large amount of gas resources, it also consumed all the energy resources that the Zerg had mined and accumulated in the underground world.

When 500,000 star-level Zerg destroyers marched towards the city where the Naga space transmission channel was located, they were very high-profile along the way, attracting the attention of many people including the Goblin Chamber of Commerce, various forces and the Alliance.

The Naga and Tengu tribes evacuated, and the personnel of various forces who were originally more concerned about this area did not evacuate with them, but continued to stay, and Wu Qing did not intend to drive these people away.

Wu Qing just needs them to promote the reputation of the Zerg. This time, the 500,000 star-level Zerg destroyers went to the Naga tribe, and they just needed to march long distances, so there was a lot to do in the middle.

Under the intentional operation of the Zerg, Wu Qing used the powerful army hatched by the resources of the Naga tribe to show the powerful strength of the Zerg to the outside forces.

"Oh my god! This is the Zerg's ultra-long-range siege troop!"

"So many troops! All of them are of star-level strength! There are also a large number of high-star-level warriors! I can't imagine it!"

"This Zerg clan is really not bragging!"

"If this Zerg army goes to the main battlefield of the camp war to participate in the war, it will be enough to change the situation in one place!"

"Looking at the direction they are marching, they should be going to the Naga tribe! Now the Naga tribe is going to take a big action!"

"..."

Except for the people of the Alliance who can only shout "I kao!", people from other forces are knowledgeable people. They can see a lot from this Zerg army.

"We are still not fast enough!"

"The Zerg has such a degree of contact with the Naga tribe so quickly!"

"The Zerg sent such a strong army to the Naga tribe at once. It seems that the tribe still underestimates the Zerg. This information must be reported immediately!"

"..."

Gong Zhe of the Goblin Chamber of Commerce saw this scene and had a lot of thoughts in his heart.

There was also a group of special people who saw this scene. They were the people sent by the Scottish Fold Cats to the Zerg territory. These people had just arrived. They wanted to cooperate with the Zerg and needed to come here to understand some of the situation.

"The Zerg has such a strong army, so it should be true that they are a big tribe!"

"I didn't expect that there would be a big tribe's initial territory next to my tribe. I don't know if it is a blessing or a curse!"

The Scottish Fold Cats saw the strength of the Zerg from this army.

All this was arranged by Wu Qing to the Queen of the Zerg. Five hundred thousand Zerg destroyers, such a strong lineup, must be used well before being sent to the Naga tribe.

Now it seems that the effect is good.

The construction of the space transmission channel of the Goblin Chamber of Commerce has been slow, and the progress should be accelerated.

The Scottish Fold Cats should soon take the initiative to invite the Zerg to the front line to watch the battle, and some cooperation between the two tribes will also be put on the agenda.

All forces will pay more attention to the Zerg.

The Alliance will also speed up the process of absorbing the vassal territories of the original Naga and Tengu tribes, develop its strength, and strive to go out as soon as possible.

…

Five hundred thousand Zerg destroyers arrived at the Naga space transmission channel, and Wu Qing's Zerg clone handed over to Naga.

Naga was very satisfied with the efficiency of the Zerg, and even more satisfied with the five hundred thousand Zerg destroyers.

Under Naga's personal supervision, the five hundred thousand Zerg destroyers were transported to the Naga tribe in turn, marking the official completion of the transaction.

As for whether this army of Zerg destroyers would be returned to the Zerg in the future, how to compensate for their losses on the battlefield, etc., neither side discussed it.

Wu Qing and Naga knew that it was useless to talk about this now. In the end, it would depend on how strong and how high the Zerg's status would be in the future.

If the Zerg was strong, the Naga would definitely double the compensation for the losses and return the army at any time; if the Zerg was not as good as it seemed, it would be reasonable for them to let the Zerg army be completely consumed on the battlefield when the Naga had already paid a great price.

Even if Naga didn't think so, she couldn't influence the other people in the Naga tribe. Her current strength and status were not enough, and her voice in the Naga tribe was weak.

This time, Naga didn't guarantee Wu Qing the safety of the Zerg destroyer like she did last time. The war that the Naga tribe was about to launch was not something she could dominate, and she couldn't help herself in many things.

Naga said to Wu Qing: "Happy cooperation!", and then entered the space transmission channel and returned to the Naga tribe.

Wu Qing looked at the empty space transmission channel, smiled, and said to himself: "I hope we can have a pleasant cooperation!"

Wu Qing never thought of returning the Zerg destroyers he sent to the Naga tribe. The harder the Naga tribe used them, the happier he was. These Zerg destroyers were all experts in earning resources.

They have already made a lot of money from the Naga tribe, and they can continue to make a lot of money on the battlefield.

The Naga tribe will re-formulate the battle plan based on the more than 500,000 Zerg destroyers of the Zerg tribe. They will launch a major battle within the unspoken rules followed by the Skeleton Tribe.

This will take some time. The Zerg destroyers will not fight for the time being, so Wu Qing will no longer pay attention to it.

……

Wu Qing's consciousness returned to his body and returned to the Zerg territory.

Now the Zerg is extremely short of energy resources. Wu Qing continues to increase the number of Zerg worker bees and speed up the mining of resources in the underground world.

When the amount of system energy resources is increased again, Wu Qing will upgrade the nearly one million main combat arms of the Zerg. After the upgrade, the Zerg main combat arms will form a strong army and go to the main battlefield of the camp war recommended by the Goblin tribe.

Before that, Wu Qing and the Queen of Zerg need to make a detailed plan first.

In terms of system energy resources, Wu Qing, who has just made a fortune from the Naga tribe, is now rich and powerful. He plans to prepare 50,000 Zerg destroyers for the Zerg army according to the star configuration standard of the Naga tribe's army soldiers.

The Naga tribe is a star army on the entire battlefield with more than 500,000 Zerg destroyers. The Zerg is now only an army, and it is equipped with 50,000 full-star Zerg destroyers, including 40,000 one-star, 9,000 two-star, 900 three-star, and 100 four-star.

It is already far beyond the standard for an army to configure such a level of ultra-long-range attack arms.

However, Wu Qing just likes strong firepower, and this configuration is not excessive.

The main ground combat force of the Zerg, Hydralisks and Roaches, Wu Qing is going to upgrade 200,000 Zerg Hydralisks and 100,000 Zerg Roaches according to the Naga standards.

These 300,000 Zerg Hydralisks and Roaches are the main force of long-range attacks in the Zerg army. They can attack both air and ground at the same time. They are all-rounders of the Zerg and can cope with complex battlefield environments.

Wu Qing is going to upgrade 50,000 Zerg Mutalisks, an important flying unit, according to the Naga standards, and follow them on the expedition.

The flying units in this world have not been encountered by the Zerg so far. The Zerg can send some flying units, but it is not advisable to be too high-profile.

The Zerg Stealth Spider, a mobile defensive ground spike, is a very effective supplement to the ground defense line. Wu Qing is going to increase their number to 10,000 and upgrade them according to the Naga standards.

The total strength of the above units is 410,000. Wu Qing is going to send out a full-star army of more than 500,000 for the first time. From the battlefield where the Naga is responsible, sending out such an army is neither high-profile nor low-profile.

The subsequent increase or decrease of troops will depend on the situation.

Wu Qing thought about it and chose to upgrade 100,000 Zerg Zerglings according to the Naga standard to make up for the missing troops.

It is not good for the Zerg army to not have a special melee army. If the strength of the Zerg Zerglings is improved, their melee strength is very strong.

Zerg Zerglings can protect other Zerg army troops at close range and can sacrifice themselves if necessary.

The basic consumption of Zerg Zerglings is low, and the resources consumed for upgrading are relatively small.

In this way, the army has 510,000 troops, plus some other auxiliary troops, the troops just meet Wu Qing's requirements.

For auxiliary troops, Wu Qing is also ready to configure them with a strong lineup.

One hundred Zerg Hosts, one hundred Zerg Queens, one hundred Exploding Swarms, and ten Transport Hosts, all of which must be upgraded to four upgrades.

Zerg Queens and Exploding Swarms can be loaded by Transport Hosts. If it is not necessary, they do not need to show up. The situation outside will definitely be complicated, and the Zerg can keep a hand.

The transport host then carried Wu Qing's four-star Zerg clone and ten four-star guards, as well as some Zerg worker bees. This Zerg army, which opened up a new direction for the Zerg, was complete.
